pages.title: Tachyon Flux
pages.text: A thin stream of faster-than-light particles. Because their mass is imaginary, they speed up as they lose energy, so the coldest flux is also the fastest. It arrives in the pipe a fraction of a moment before I open the valve.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pumping tachyon crystal with superfluid helium in the Tachyon Resonator, I drained energy from the cavity and the readings jumped ahead of the clock. Faster-than-light particles, slowing by speeding up.
